issue_title: CSP blocks Meta Pixel's form POST to www.facebook.com/tr/ (form-action 'self')
problem_statement:
CSP blocks Meta Pixel's form POST to www.facebook.com/tr/ (form-action 'self')

## Problem
On events.allthingsai.org (2026-10-12 check), the browser console logs:

> Sending form data to 'https://www.facebook.com/tr/' violates the following Content Security Policy directive: "form-action 'self'".

Meta Pixel (fbevents.js 2.9.x) falls back to a hidden-form POST to `https://www.facebook.com/tr/` when an event payload is too large for its GET beacon. `form-action 'self'` blocks that, so those events are lost. The GET beacon (`img-src https://www.facebook.com`) already works.

## Fix
Add the exact origin `https://www.facebook.com` to `form-action` in `src/lib/security-headers.ts`, plus a unit test that pins `form-action` to exactly `'self' https://www.facebook.com` (no wildcards).

## Explicitly not in scope
The pixel also tries `connect-src` to rotating hosts like `https://<id>.ecs.us-west-2.on.aws/events?cee=no` and `https://<id>.us-central1.run.app/events?cee=no`. Allowlisting `*.on.aws` / `*.run.app` would let any script exfiltrate to any AWS Lambda/ECS or Cloud Run service on a page with Clerk auth and Stripe, so they stay blocked. Those calls are optional; the pixel's core events don't depend on them.

## Acceptance
